metadata.source_inspiration: Compiled from analysis of 22 premium catering websites including Wolfgang Puck, Creative Edge, Elegant Affairs, Ridgewells, Concorde, and others
metadata.usage_note: These are representative samples based on industry patterns. Use as templates and inspiration for menu development.

appetizers.name: Pan-Seared Scallops with Citrus Beurre Blanc
appetizers.description: Diver scallops seared to golden perfection, finished with a bright citrus butter sauce, served with crispy pancetta lardons and pea shoot salad.

appetizers.name: Burrata Cheese with Heirloom Tomatoes
appetizers.description: Creamy center-filled burrata from Puglia, arranged with a rainbow of heirloom tomatoes at peak ripeness, basil oil, aged balsamic reduction, and flaky sea salt.

appetizers.name: Tuna Tartare with Avocado Mousse
appetizers.description: Fresh yellowfin tuna hand-cut and seasoned with sesame and yuzu, topped with creamy avocado mousse, wonton crisps, and cilantro microgreens.

appetizers.name: Mini Crab Cakes with Remoulade
appetizers.description: Jumbo lump blue crab, barely bound and pan-fried until golden, served with house-made remoulade featuring cornichons and capers, pickled shallots on the side.

appetizers.name: Prosciutto-Wrapped Figs with Goat Cheese
appetizers.description: Mission figs stuffed with herbed goat cheese, wrapped in 24-month aged prosciutto di Parma, drizzled with wild honey and fresh thyme.

appetizers.name: Lobster Bisque Shooters
appetizers.description: Rich lobster bisque finished with cognac and heavy cream, served in elegant shot glasses with a dollop of chive crème fraîche and miniature toast points.

appetizers.name: Beef Carpaccio with Truffle Vinaigrette
appetizers.description: Paper-thin sliced prime beef tenderloin, dressed with black truffle vinaigrette, shaved Parmigiano-Reggiano, caper berries, and arugula.

appetizers.name: Wild Mushroom Arancini
appetizers.description: Crispy risotto balls filled with fontina and wild mushrooms (chanterelle, oyster, shiitake), served with marinara dipping sauce and fresh basil.

appetizers.name: Smoked Salmon Napoleon
appetizers.description: Layers of house-cured Atlantic salmon, dill cream cheese, capers, red onion, and brioche in an elegant stacked presentation with lemon crème fraîche.

appetizers.name: Grilled Octopus with Fingerling Potatoes
appetizers.description: Spanish octopus tenderized and char-grilled until caramelized, served with warm fingerling potatoes, fennel salad, and smoked paprika aioli.

appetizers.name: Foie Gras Torchon with Brioche
appetizers.description: Silky duck foie gras prepared in the traditional torchon method, served with toasted brioche, fig compote, and fleur de sel.

appetizers.name: Shrimp Cocktail with Spicy Remoulade
appetizers.description: Jumbo poached shrimp chilled and arranged around a vessel of zesty remoulade with horseradish and Old Bay seasoning, lemon wedges.

appetizers.name: Caprese Skewers with Balsamic Glaze
appetizers.description: Fresh mozzarella pearls, cherry tomato halves, and fresh basil threaded on decorative skewers, finished with balsamic glaze drizzle and extra virgin olive oil.

appetizers.name: Chicken Satay with Peanut Sauce
appetizers.description: Marinated chicken thigh skewers grilled over charcoal, served with rich peanut sauce, cucumber relish, and pressed rice cakes.

appetizers.name: Spinach Artichoke Dip with Crostini
appetizers.description: Warm, creamy blend of spinach, artichoke hearts, parmesan, and cream cheese, served bubbling with toasted baguette crostini for dipping.

entrees.name: Pan-Seared Halibut with Lemon Caper Butter
entrees.description: Sustainable Pacific halibut fillet pan-seared to achieve crispy skin and flaky interior, finished with brown butter, capers, fresh lemon, and herbs. Served with sautéed haricots verts and fingerling potatoes.

entrees.name: Filet Mignon with Bordelaise Sauce
entrees.description: USDA Prime center-cut filet mignon, aged minimum 28 days, seared to develop deep flavor crust while maintaining juicy medium-rare interior. Topped with classic Bordelaise made from reduced cabernet, shallots, and bone marrow. Served with truffle mashed potatoes and broccolini.

entrees.name: Herb-Crusted Rack of Lamb with Rosemary Jus
entrees.description: Frenched rack of domestic lamb coated in Dijon, garlic, and fresh herb crust, roasted to rosy perfection. Sliced into double chops with natural jus enhanced by rosemary and lamb stock. Accompanied by potato gratin and glazed carrots.

entrees.name: Butter-Braised Short Ribs with Creamy Polenta
entrees.description: Heritage beef short ribs slowly braised for eight hours in red wine, beef stock, and aromatic vegetables until fork-tender. The meat develops deep, concentrated flavor with a beautiful mahogany color. Served over creamy parmesan polenta with braised rainbow chard.

entrees.name: Duck Breast with Cherry Reduction
entrees.description: Moulard duck breast scored and seared skin-side down until crackly, cooked to rosy medium-rare. Served with tart cherry port wine reduction, celery root purée, and sautéed Brussels sprouts with pancetta.

entrees.name: Free-Range Chicken with Truffle Risotto
entrees.description: Air-chilled chicken breast stuffed with herbed goat cheese and sun-dried tomatoes, roasted until golden with crisp skin. Finished with white wine pan sauce. Served alongside creamy arborio risotto with truffle oil and shaved Parmigiano.

entrees.name: Salmon en Croûte with Spinach
entrees.description: Atlantic salmon fillet atop a bed of wilted spinach and ricotta, wrapped in puff pastry and baked until golden. Served with hollandaise, steamed asparagus, and lemon beurre blanc.

entrees.name: Seafood Paella for Two
entrees.description: Traditional Spanish paella prepared with bomba rice, saffron-infused broth, loaded with shrimp, mussels, clams, calamari, and chorizo. Finished with peas, red peppers, and fresh lemon. Served tableside from traditional pan.

entrees.name: Eggplant Parmesan Stack
entrees.description: Layers of breaded eggplant, house-made marinara, fresh mozzarella, and Parmesan, baked until bubbly and golden. Topped with fresh basil and extra virgin olive oil. Served with garlic focaccia or over spaghetti.

entrees.name: Portobello Mushroom Wellington
entrees.description: Large portobello mushroom caps marinated in balsamic and herbs, wrapped in puff pastry with spinach, caramelized onions, and goat cheese. Served with red wine reduction and roasted root vegetables.

entrees.name: Pork Tenderloin with Apple Cider Glaze
entrees.description: Whole pork tenderloast rubbed with fennel seed and sage, roasted until blushing pink, finished with apple cider reduction with Calvados. Served with sweet potato gratin and Brussels sprouts with bacon.

entrees.name: Chilean Sea Bass with Miso Glaze
entrees.description: Premium Chilean sea bass fillet marinated in white miso, sake, and mirin, then broiled until caramelized and flaky. Served with jasmine rice, stir-fried bok choy, and ginger soy drizzle.

entrees.name: Veal Osso Buco with Gremolata
entrees.description: Veal shanks braised low and slow in white wine, tomatoes, and vegetables until falling off the bone. Served over creamy saffron risotto with traditional gremolata of lemon zest, garlic, and parsley.

entrees.name: Vegetable Terrine with Herb Coulis
entrees.description: Layers of roasted vegetables (eggplant, zucchini, bell peppers, tomato) pressed into a terrine with herb-infused olive oil, served cold with basil coulis, toasted pine nuts, and microgreens.

entrees.name: Lobster Thermidor
entrees.description: Whole Maine lobster split and filled with creamy cognac sauce with Gruyère and Parmesan, broiled until golden and bubbling. Served with drawn butter, lemon, and steamed broccoli.

entrees.name: Rack of Wild Boar with Juniper Berry Sauce
entrees.description: Frenched wild boar rack marinated overnight, roasted with juniper berries and red wine. Game meat with rich, distinctive flavor. Served with spaetzle, red cabbage, and lingonberry compote.

sides.name: Truffle Mashed Potatoes
sides.description: Russet and Yukon gold potatoes whipped with cream, butter, and black truffle oil, finished with grated Parmigiano-Reggiano.

sides.name: Roasted Brussels Sprouts with Pancetta
sides.description: Halved Brussels sprouts roasted until caramelized edges form, tossed with crispy pancetta cubes and finished with balsamic glaze.

sides.name: Creamy Polenta with Aged Parmesan
sides.description: Stone-ground yellow cornmeal cooked slowly with cream and butter until silky smooth, folded with aged Parmigiano-Reggiano and cracked black pepper.

sides.name: Grilled Asparagus with Hollandaise
sides.description: Thick-stalked asparagus grilled until tender-crisp with attractive char marks, topped with classic hollandaise sauce and finishing salt.

sides.name: Wild Rice Pilaf with Mushrooms
sides.description: Minnesota wild rice blend with arborio, toasted pecans, dried cranberries, and sautéed wild mushrooms in herb butter.

sides.name: Macaroni and Cheese Four-Cheese
sides.description: Elbow macaroni in creamy sauce of sharp cheddar, Gruyère, Fontina, and Parmesan, topped with panko breadcrumbs and baked until golden bubbly.

sides.name: Roasted Root Vegetable Medley
sides.description: Seasonal root vegetables (carrots, parsnips, turnips, beets) tossed in herb oil and honey, roasted until tender and caramelized, finished with fresh thyme.

sides.name: Sautéed Green Beans Almondine
sides.description: Fresh green beans blanched then sautéed with garlic butter, toasted slivered almonds, and a squeeze of fresh lemon juice.

sides.name: Potato Gratin Dauphinois
sides.description: Thinly sliced potatoes layered with garlic-infused cream, nutmeg, and Gruyère cheese, baked until golden and custardy throughout.

sides.name: Cornbread with Honey Butter
sides.description: Moist, slightly sweet cornbread made with stone-ground cornmeal, served warm with whipped honey butter and flake salt.

sides.name: Glazed Carrots with Thyme
sides.description: Baby carrots glazed in butter and honey with fresh thyme sprigs, cooked until tender but still holding shape, glossy finish.

sides.name: Cauliflower Gratin with Gruyère
sides.description: Fresh cauliflower florets in béchamel sauce with shredded Gruyère, topped with more cheese and breadcrumbs, baked until bubbling golden.

desserts.name: Chocolate Lava Cake with Vanilla Gelato
desserts.description: Individual dark chocolate cake with molten center, served warm alongside vanilla bean gelato, fresh berries, and chocolate shard garnish.

desserts.name: Crème Brûlée Trio
desserts.description: Classic vanilla bean, espresso, and passion fruit crème brûlées with signature crackling caramelized sugar tops, served with shortbread cookies.

desserts.name: New York Cheesecake with Berry Compote
desserts.description: Dense, creamy New York-style cheesecake on graham cracker crust, topped with seasonal berry compote (strawberry, blueberry, raspberry) and whipped cream.

desserts.name: Tiramisu
desserts.description: Classic Italian dessert of espresso-soaked ladyfingers layered with mascarpone cream, dusted generously with cocoa powder, served chilled.

desserts.name: Seasonal Fruit Tart with Pastry Cream
desserts.description: Buttery shortcrust shell filled with vanilla pastry cream, artfully arranged with seasonal fruits (stone fruits summer, citrus winter), glazed with apricot jam.

desserts.name: Bread Pudding with Bourbon Sauce
desserts.description: Rich bread pudding made from brioche and croissants with raisins and cinnamon, served warm with boozy bourbon anglaise sauce and vanilla ice cream.

desserts.name: Panna Cotta with Raspberry Coulis
desserts.description: Silky Italian cream pudding set with gelatin, served chilled with vibrant raspberry coulis and fresh mint garnish.

desserts.name: Apple Pie à la Mode
desserts.description: Classic double-crust apple pie with cinnamon-spiced filling of Granny Smith and Honeycrisp apples, served warm with vanilla ice cream.

desserts.name: Flourless Chocolate Torte
desserts.description: Intense dark chocolate cake made without flour, dense and fudgy texture, served with raspberry coulis and whipped cream. Naturally gluten-free.

desserts.name: Lemon Meringue Tartlets
desserts.description: Tart and tangy lemon curd in buttery tart shells, crowned with toasted Italian meringue, served at room temperature.

desserts.name: Cheese Course Selection
desserts.description: Artisan cheese board featuring 4-5 selections (soft-ripened, bloomy rind, firm, blue), served with house-made crackers, honeycomb, seasonal fruit, and nuts.

desserts.name: Petit Four Assortment
desserts.description: Elegant selection of mini desserts including macarons, chocolate truffles, mini éclairs, fruit jellies, and financiers, perfect for coffee service or late-night treat.

beverages.name: Signature Cocktails - Choose 2
beverages.description: Selection includes: Elderflower Spritz (St. Germain, prosecco, cucumber), Old Fashioned (bourbon, bitters, orange), Moscow Mule (vodka, ginger beer, lime), Margarita (tequila, Cointreau, fresh lime).

beverages.name: Premium Wine Package
beverages.description: Curated selection including: Chardonnay (California), Sauvignon Blanc (New Zealand), Pinot Noir (Oregon), Cabernet Sauvignon (Napa Valley), Prosecco (Italy). 5-hour open bar format.

beverages.name: Craft Beer Selection
beverages.description: Rotating selection of 4 craft beers featuring local breweries plus one domestic light option. Includes IPA, Stout/Porter, Lager, Wheat/Hefeweizen styles.

beverages.name: Champagne Toast Package
beverages.description: Glass of premium Champagne (Veuve Clicquot or equivalent) for each guest during toasts. Upgrade options available for Dom Perignon or Krug.

beverages.name: Non-Alcoholic Beverage Station
beverages.description: Artisanal mocktails (Virgin Mojito, Cucumber Cooler, Sparkling Berry), craft sodas, premium sparkling waters, fresh-squeezed juices, specialty coffees and teas.

beverages.name: Coffee & Espresso Service
beverages.description: Full-service coffee station with freshly brewed regular and decaf coffee, espresso-based drinks (lattes, cappuccinos, americanos), assorted teas, and accompaniments (biscotti, cookies).

beverages.name: Hot Chocolate Bar
beverages.description: Premium Belgian hot chocolate base with toppings bar: whipped cream, marshmallows, crushed peppermint, cinnamon sticks, chocolate shavings, flavored syrups (hazelnut, caramel, peppermint).

beverages.name: Lemonade & Iced Tea Station
beverages.description: Fresh-squeezed lemonade (regular and raspberry), brewed iced tea (sweetened and unsweetened, peach variant available), infused water station with cucumber, mint, citrus.

stations.name: Carving Station Prime
stations.description: Chef-carved proteins sliced to order: Slow-roasted Prime Rib au Jus (herb-crusted exterior, rosy interior), Roasted Turkey Breast with Cranberry Chutney, Honey-Glazed Ham with Cloves. Served with Yorkshire puddings, horseradish sauces, and gravy boat.

stations.name: Pasta Perfected Station
stations.description: Fresh pasta cooked to order in theatrical open kitchen display. Pasta choices: Fettuccine, Pappardelle, Orecchiette, Gnocchi. Sauce options: Wild Mushroom Ragu, Vodka Sauce with Pancetta, Fresh Tomato Basil with Burrata, Carbonara, Pesto Genovese. Tableside Parmigiano grating.

stations.name: Seafood Tower Display
stations.description: Dramatic ice sculpture or tiered stand presentation featuring: Jumbo Shrimp Cocktail, Fresh Oysters on Half Shell (with mignonettes), Crab Claws, Lobster Claw Meat, Smoked Salmon Platter with Traditional Garnishes. Lemon wedges and cocktail sauces abundant.

stations.name: Slider Bar
stations.description: Gourmet mini-burger assembly: Angus Beef Sliders (with choice of cheeses, caramelized onions, bacon jam), Crispy Chicken Sliders (with coleslaw, pickles, special sauce), Portobello Veggie Sliders (with goat cheese spread, roasted peppers). Bun options including brioche and pretzel.

stations.name: Taco Station
stations.description: Build-your-own taco bar with warm corn and flour tortillas: Carne Asada (marinated skirt steak), Citrus-Marinated Chicken, Beer-Battered Fish, Roasted Vegetable & Black Bean. Toppings bar: salsas (roja, verde, pico), guacamole, queso, pickled onions, radishes, cilantro, lime wedges.

stations.name: Mashed Potato Bar
stations.description: Large vessel of creamy mashed potatoes with extensive topping selection: Bacon bits, cheddar cheese, sour cream, chives, caramelized onions, sautéed mushrooms, broccoli, corn, fried onion strings, gravies (traditional, mushroom, sausage).

stations.name: Omelet Station
stations.description: Fresh eggs cooked to order with extensive ingredient choices: Assorted cheeses (cheddar, Swiss, feta, goat), Vegetables (peppers, onions, mushrooms, spinach, tomatoes, asparagus), Proteins (bacon, sausage, ham, smoked salmon, crab), Herbs and seasonings. Served with toast points or tortilla option.

stations.name: Waffle Station
stations.description: Belgian waffles made fresh to golden crispness. Toppings bar: Fresh berries and fruit compotes, Whipped cream, Chocolate chips, Nuts (pecans, walnuts, almonds), Syrups (maple, berry, chocolate, caramel), Powdered sugar shaker, Ice cream option for dessert waffles.

stations.name: Antipasto Display
stations.description: Beautifully arranged grazing display featuring: Imported cured meats (prosciutto di Parma, Spanish chorizo, salumi selection), Artisan cheeses (variety of textures and milk types), Marinated olives, Roasted peppers, Artichoke hearts, Fresh and dried fruits, Various crackers and breadsticks, Mustards and honeycomb.

stations.name: Grazing Table Complete
stations.description: Full visual feast table combining elements: Charcuterie and cheese selections, Fresh vegetable crudités with dips (hummus, ranch, spinach artichoke), Bruschetta bar with various toppings, Dried fruits and nuts, Artisan breads and crackers, Small bites (olives, cornichons, deviled eggs), Edible flowers and greenery for visual impact.

dietary_specialty_items.name: Vegan Buddha Bowl
dietary_specialty_items.description: Quinoa base topped with roasted chickpeas, avocado massaged kale, pickled vegetables, tahini dressing, pumpkin seeds, and microgreens. Completely plant-based and nutrient-dense.

dietary_specialty_items.name: Gluten-Free Pasta Primavera
dietary_specialty_items.description: Brown rice fusilli with spring vegetables (asparagus, peas, cherry tomatoes) in garlic olive oil with fresh basil and nutritional yeast 'parmesan'.

dietary_specialty_items.name: Dairy-Free Coconut Curry
dietary_specialty_items.description: Aromatic Thai-inspired curry with vegetables and tofu in rich coconut milk base, lemongrass, galangal, kaffir lime leaves. Served with jasmine rice.

dietary_specialty_items.name: Kosher-Style Brisket
dietary_specialty_items.description: Traditional Jewish-style brisket braised with onions and seasonings under rabbinical supervision or kosher-style preparation. Served with potato latkes and braised cabbage.
dietary_specialty_items.certification_note: Verify certification requirements per client needs

dietary_specialty_items.name: Halal Chicken Shawarma Plate
dietary_specialty_items.description: Spice-marinated chicken thighs roasted on vertical rotisserie, thinly sliced, served over basmati rice with hummus, tabbouleh, pickled turnips, and sumac onions.
dietary_specialty_items.certification_note: Verify halal sourcing per client requirements
